dedupe_keys.name: os mastermap highways network roads great britain ordnance survey

description: OS MasterMap Highways Network – Roads is Ordnance Survey's detailed navigable road network for Great Britain. It records the dimensions and accessibility of roads, with road geometry carrying unique identifiers such as the Unique Street Reference Number (USRN) and topographic identifiers (TOIDs), and it includes planned roads and roads under construction. It combines surveyed OS data with the National Street Gazetteer, local highway authorities' road names, numbering and maintenance responsibility, the Trunk Road Street Gazetteer of Highways England and the Welsh Government, and the Scottish Street Gazetteer. Coverage is national (Great Britain) at 1:1,250 to 1:10,000 scale, published monthly as GML, GeoPackage or vector tiles, for all of Great Britain or a user-defined area. Access is free for members of the Public Sector Geospatial Agreement (PSGA); businesses and developers obtain it through OS, and free sample data for Exeter can be downloaded from the OS Data Hub. Caveats: it is not open data for users outside the public sector agreement, and outside users must arrange access with OS. It supports detailed road network models, routing for emergency service planning, asset and maintenance responsibility mapping and hazard exposure of roads. It complements OS Open Roads and the National Highways network model catalogued here.
